name: Does my kitchen faucet have to match my sink exactly?

mainEntity.name: Does my kitchen faucet have to match my sink exactly?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, they do **not** have to be identical, but they should feel intentional together. Most homeowners get the best result by matching the overall style and coordinating finishes instead of forcing an exact match.
acceptedAnswer.description: No. They can differ, but they should share the same style direction and coordinate finishes for a cohesive look.
